topic: A tiger from Maharashtra may be roaming
hook: A tiger from Maharashtra may be roaming farms in *Adilabad*
hook_b: A tiger from Maharashtra may be roaming farms in *Adilabad*
tldr: Forest officials are tracking a tiger near Bheempur and Tamsi after panic among farmers.

beats.care: Villagers: avoid fields at dawn and dusk and report sightings to forest staff.
